# Promo video — storyboard & After Effects guide

**Title:** Farrukh · Dev Hub — Playable 3D Portfolio
**Length:** 46 s · **Format:** 16:9, 30 fps (AE comp 1920×1080; the quick-render MP4 is 1280×720)
**Style:** dark navy + neon (cyan `#22d3ee`, violet `#8b5cf6`, pink `#f472b6`, green `#34d399`, amber `#fbbf24`), Orbitron type, perspective grid floor, glow on all text.
**Music:** 110 BPM, A-minor synthwave (Am – F – C – G). The track in `audio/promo-music.wav` is original and generated by `render_promo.py`, so it is free to use. If you swap in stock music, keep the licence/credit in your report.

## Build it in After Effects (≈ 1–2 hours)

1. **Install fonts:** `video/fonts/orbitron-700.ttf` and `orbitron-500.ttf`.
2. **Run the starter script:** File ▸ Scripts ▸ Run Script File… ▸ `build_promo_comp.jsx`, then pick the `assets` folder when asked.
   It creates the 1920×1080 comp, imports the images and music, and lays out every scene with text, timing, fades, slides and the 0 → 37 counter.
   *(Enable Edit ▸ Preferences ▸ Scripting & Expressions ▸ "Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network" if AE asks.)*
3. **Polish (this is where the grade comes from):**
   - Add **Effect ▸ Stylize ▸ Glow** to the text layers (threshold ~40 %, radius 25, intensity 1.2).
   - Add a perspective grid floor: new Solid ▸ **Effect ▸ Generate ▸ Grid**, enable 3D, rotate X 80°, animate Y position for the scrolling-floor feel.
   - Replace image layers' masks with rounded rectangles (Layer ▸ Mask ▸ Shape) and add a neon stroke.
   - Add **Easy Ease** (F9) to every keyframe, and a few **Wiggle** expressions for float.
   - Optional: swap in your own screen recordings of the game for the screenshots.
4. **Save** the project as `promo.aep` (File ▸ Save).
5. **Export:** Composition ▸ Add to Adobe Media Encoder Queue ▸ H.264, 1080p, 30 fps, VBR 8–10 Mbps, AAC 192 kbps ▸ `public/videos/promo.mp4`.

## Deliverables checklist (Module 3)
- [ ] Final MP4 (30–60 s) — placeholder already at `public/videos/promo.mp4`, replace with your AE export
- [ ] `promo.aep` After Effects project
- [ ] Music licence note (or "original, generated" statement)
- [ ] Name + intro, skills/projects/achievements, typography, transitions, effects — all covered by scenes 1–8
